text:
Lost, you say?  Why, haven't you always been lost?  We're all adrift on a sea of unknowing, my friend! The only certainty is uncertainty, after all.

But fear not the fog! Embrace the disorientation! For in the labyrinth of bewilderment lies the hidden treasure of discovery.  

So tell me, what are you looking for? Unless, of course, you're not looking for anything at all... are you?
